methodology.description: Shared CSV fixtures; data loaded once; model fit timed per metric; Julia JIT warmed up.
methodology.note: Speed claims require converged LMM fits with matching objectives/coefficients. GLMM equivalence remains unverified.
methodology.timing_boundary: Fresh model construction and fit on loaded data; warmed runtime; excludes destruction and fit-check extraction. Not process-cold latency.
methodology.execution_order: julia-first per case; separate processes; no between-session uncertainty estimate.
